truth.rule: Authorization is not settlement is not payout is not bank-available cash.

offers.name: Backlog Rescue — one owned ticket
offers.buyer_job: Turn one named repository issue into a human-owned, ready-to-merge pull request.
offers.clock: 48 hours after locked inputs and access
inputs: one issue URL and written acceptance criteria
deliverables: one scoped pull request, preferably no more than 400 changed lines
available project tests and CI green
human review note naming risks and decisions
8-bit status card: OPEN to REVIEW to CI GREEN
acceptance: pull request addresses the locked issue
offers.refund_boundary: Full refund if the agreed ready-to-merge acceptance is not met after the included cure; scope changes require a new quote.
exclusions: no claim that token volume or agent count is the product
no production deployment unless separately written
no customer code or secrets posted to Commons

offers.name: Accessible meeting packet
offers.buyer_job: Make one public-meeting packet usable by people using screen readers, reflow, keyboard navigation, or accessible text.
offers.clock: 48 hours after source review and locked scope
inputs: one source packet up to 80 pages
deliverables: remediated PDF where the source permits
headings, reading order, links, alt text, and tables addressed
acceptance: known source limitations are written, not hidden
offers.refund_boundary: Scope and price are confirmed after source inspection; unreadable scans or unusually complex forms are requoted before payment.
exclusions: not a certification of statutory compliance
no invention of missing source meaning

offers.name: Security questionnaire sprint
offers.buyer_job: Turn a stalled customer security questionnaire into an evidence-linked response workbook.
offers.clock: 48 hours after evidence access and locked scope
inputs: customer policies, architecture notes, and prior approved answers
deliverables: completed response workbook based only on supplied evidence
acceptance: every in-scope question is answered or explicitly flagged
offers.refund_boundary: Missing evidence is flagged instead of invented; material scope expansion is requoted before work continues.
exclusions: no attestation, audit opinion, or legal advice
no submission to the end customer unless separately authorized

offers.name: Pixel agent pack
offers.buyer_job: Give one product, community, or internal agent a recognizable original 8-bit identity that moves.
offers.clock: 48 hours after the visual brief is locked
deliverables: idle, think, error, and done loops
transparent sprite sheet and preview GIF
acceptance: exports match the locked grid and palette
offers.refund_boundary: Full refund if the agreed export set is not delivered after the included cure; style copying and trademark imitation are refused.
exclusions: no copied game, anime, or company character
no claim that AI generation alone is the value
larger eight-direction animation sets are separately quoted

Preserved; not marketed as the first-dollar path.
